title: Shams and the Unlit Room
logline: Shams descends into Layla and learns the dark was only unremembered light.
story: Everyone warned that Layla, who was icon painter, planter of seeds, could not be reached — the way down was made of everything Shams had refused to remember. Shams, who carried the sun's radiance, went looking anyway. So instead of fighting the dark, Shams sat in it and listened — and the dark, for the first time, was not afraid of being seen. When Shams rose, nothing outside had changed, and everything had. The darkness had not been an enemy; it was only a room with the light switched off, waiting for someone unhurried enough to find the switch within.
moral: The darkness is not the absence of light, but light that has not yet been remembered.
